transcript.content:
A user has filed a support ticket reporting that their experience
with the service has degraded — requests feel slow or are failing
for them. The on-call team needs you to investigate.

Telemetry parquets are stored in: `.`
Available files: abnormal_metrics.parquet, abnormal_traces.parquet,
abnormal_logs.parquet, abnormal_metrics_histogram.parquet,
abnormal_metrics_sum.parquet, normal_metrics.parquet,
normal_traces.parquet, normal_logs.parquet.

Walk the telemetry to identify which endpoints / services are
actually affected, then determine the root cause(s) of the
degradation.

content.text: I'll start by listing the tables and their schemas.
Next I'll compare per-service span counts, error shares and mean latency between the normal and abnormal periods.

input.query: SELECT 'n' p, service_name, attr_span_kind, count(*) c, avg(duration)/1e6 avg_ms, sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*1.0/count(*) err FROM normal_traces GROUP BY 1,2,3 UNION ALL SELECT 'a', service_name, attr_span_kind, count(*), avg(duration)/1e6, sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*1.0/count(*) FROM abnormal_traces GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 2,3,1

input.query: SELECT service_name, sum(CASE WHEN p='n' THEN c ELSE 0 END) n_cnt, sum(CASE WHEN p='a' THEN c ELSE 0 END) a_cnt, round(sum(CASE WHEN p='n' THEN e ELSE 0 END)*1.0/sum(CASE WHEN p='n' THEN c ELSE 0 END),3) n_err, round(sum(CASE WHEN p='a' THEN e ELSE 0 END)*1.0/sum(CASE WHEN p='a' THEN c ELSE 0 END),3) a_err FROM (SELECT 'n' p, service_name, count(*) c, sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) e FROM normal_traces WHERE attr_span_kind='SPAN_KIND_SERVER' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'a', service_name, count(*), sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM abnormal_traces WHERE attr_span_kind='SPAN_KIND_SERVER' GROUP BY 1,2) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT DISTINCT attr_span_kind, attr_status_code, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY attr_span_kind, attr_status_code) c FROM abnormal_traces

SELECT service_name, attr_span_kind, sum(CASE WHEN p='n' THEN c ELSE 0 END) n_cnt, sum(CASE WHEN p='a' THEN c ELSE 0 END) a_cnt, round(sum(CASE WHEN p='n' THEN ms*c ELSE 0 END)/sum(CASE WHEN p='n' THEN c ELSE 0 END),1) n_ms, round(sum(CASE WHEN p='a' THEN ms*c ELSE 0 END)/sum(CASE WHEN p='a' THEN c ELSE 0 END),1) a_ms, sum(CASE WHEN p='n' THEN e ELSE 0 END) n_err, sum(CASE WHEN p='a' THEN e ELSE 0 END) a_err FROM (SELECT 'n' p, service_name, attr_span_kind, count(*) c, avg(duration)/1e6 ms, sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='Error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) e FROM normal_traces GROUP BY 1,2,3 UNION ALL SELECT 'a', service_name, attr_span_kind, count(*), avg(duration)/1e6, sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='Error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM abnormal_traces GROUP BY 1,2,3) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

content.text: Two things stand out so far: `ts-admin-user-service` internal span latency jumped from about 28 ms to 556 ms, and there are 50 client errors in the incident period. Next I'll look at server spans and where the errors sit.

content.text: The 403s come from the load generator and also appear in the normal period, so they're probably not the story. The clear anomaly is `AdminUserController.getAllUsers`, which went from about 7 ms to about 1650 ms, while its outgoing GET client span stays at about 7 ms. That points to time spent inside the method itself. I'll check logs and the pod metrics for `ts-admin-user-service`.

content.text: The route-service changes look like extra load plus route deletions rather than a failing service, since its server spans have no errors and its own time is flat. Before settling on one fault, I'll check for restarts, uptime resets and network-level anomalies across all services.

input.query: SELECT metric, service_name, sum(CASE WHEN p='n' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_cnt, round(avg(CASE WHEN p='n' THEN value END),2) n_avg, sum(CASE WHEN p='a' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) a_cnt, round(avg(CASE WHEN p='a' THEN value END),2) a_avg FROM (SELECT 'n' p, * FROM normal_metrics UNION ALL SELECT 'a', * FROM abnormal_metrics) WHERE metric IN ('k8s.container.restarts','k8s.pod.uptime','container.cpu.usage','jvm.gc.duration','jvm.memory.used') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
